item.title: Reverie: Old Folks Need No Bitter Pills
item.description: Wayne’s old age caught up with his maw,quivering and clattering his fusty molars,which made him ask no one in particular,Know what the good Lord goofed?–,He should’ve left the gnashers alone(without them bones you can’t gnashand mash the game and stake): ought Hehave rid old pros of the thingy insteadcause old folks need no biter pills.

item.title: Remember This: The vantage loaf
item.description: During the holidays, we spend a lot of time and effort on what we eat. One mandatory item on most of our tables is bread, one of the oldest prepared foods. item.title: Atamah takes home SLC Player of the Week

item.description: The Natchitoches Parish School Board’s Central Office proudly wrapped up its canned food drive with the first-ever Chili Cook-Off, embracing this year’s theme: “Stompin’ Out Hunger.” Throughout November, Central Office staff partnered with the Central Louisiana Food Bank to collect hundreds of non-perishable items to support local families in need.
